meta.name: deeptools
meta.description: NGS analysis toolkit. BAM to bigWig conversion, QC (correlation, PCA, fingerprints), heatmaps/profiles (TSS, peaks), for ChIP-seq, RNA-seq, ATAC-seq visualization.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将高通量测序数据转化为可视化分析图表
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在分析ChIP-seq、RNA-seq或ATAC-seq数据
copy.tagline_en: Transform high-throughput sequencing data into visualization and analysis
copy.fit_line_en: For you if analyzing ChIP-seq, RNA-seq, or ATAC-seq data

howto.what: 装上后，Claude能用deepTools命令行工具处理高通量测序数据：转换BAM为bigWig、进行质量控制（相关性、PCA、指纹图）、绘制基因区域热图与剖面图，适用于ChIP-seq、RNA-seq、ATAC-seq分析。
howto.when: 当用户提出BAM转bigWig、QC（相关性/PCA/指纹图）、TSS或峰区热图/剖面图等NGS分析需求时触发。

say.text: 把这几个BAM文件转成bigWig，用RPGC归一化
say.note: 运行bamCoverage生成归一化覆盖度轨迹

say.text: 对这两个样本做相关性分析，画个热图
在TSS周围画ChIP信号的热图和剖面图

howto.what_en: Claude can now use deepTools to convert BAM to bigWig, run QC (correlation, PCA, fingerprint), and make heatmaps/profiles around genomic features for ChIP-seq, RNA-seq, ATAC-seq.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks for NGS analysis such as BAM-to-bigWig conversion, QC (correlation/PCA/fingerprint), or heatmaps/profiles around TSS or peaks.

say_en.text: Convert these BAM files to bigWig with RPGC normalization.
say_en.note: Runs bamCoverage to produce normalized coverage tracks.

say_en.text: Compare these two samples with correlation and draw a heatmap.
Plot ChIP signal as heatmap and profile around TSS.
